load_settings_corrupt.detail:
An error occurred while reading the YouTube TV configuration.
This may be caused by incorrect writing or file tampering.
Would you like to reset to default settings?

update_available.detail:
A new version of YouTube TV is available.
Would you like to visit the download site?

resolution.title: Maximum resolution
resolution.explanation_1: Limits the maximum resolution this device is capable of rendering.

keepSize.title: Keep window size
keepSize.explanation_1: YouTube TV will reopen exactly as it was closed, restoring its size, screen position, and maximized state.

dial.title: Connectivity
dial.explanation_1: Cast content from the YouTube app on your phone.

background.title: Background mode
background.explanation_1: YouTube TV will stay minimized and switch to full screen when a device connects.
